adapter.note: M6 and M7 are facility-level: their numbers describe the gate and the yard across every container in this request, not the container on screen. They are returned in facility_summary for exactly that reason.

model_questions.UC2-M1: How many hours will this box sit before it leaves the terminal?
model_questions.UC2-M2: How long is this train on the siding, from arrival to departure?
model_questions.UC2-M3: How many trucks will be queued at the gate in the next hour?
model_questions.UC2-M4: Is this container's document and event chain broken, and how?
model_questions.UC2-M5: Is this vessel running to plan, and when does she finish working?
model_questions.UC2-M6: Lanes are down or demand has shifted -- how should the gate be run?
model_questions.UC2-M7: Are there enough empties in the pool, and enough reefer plugs?

glossary.degraded: A fallback produced this number. Render the badge.
glossary.headline: One line fit for a card title.
glossary.engine: Which engine actually computed this: the learned model, or the documented fallback it degrades to.
glossary.decision_path: One-line audit trail of the choices behind this number: engine, data series, split protocol, caller-supplied inputs.
glossary.moduleId: Which UC-II model produced this block.
glossary.model_version: Version of the model that produced this number.
glossary.trained_at: When the model behind this number was last trained.
glossary.dwellHours: Predicted hours between gate-in and gate-out for this container.
glossary.windowHours: The p10-p90 band around the dwell prediction. Read the band, not the point.
glossary.p10Hours: 10th percentile of the dwell forecast -- the optimistic end.
glossary.p50Hours: Median of the dwell forecast. This is the headline figure.
glossary.p90Hours: 90th percentile of the dwell forecast -- the pessimistic end.
glossary.predictedDepartureWindowH: The forecast band expressed as hours from gate-in.
glossary.predictedDepartureUtc: Calendar time this container is forecast to leave, computed by the service so the UI does no date arithmetic.
glossary.predictedDepartureWindowUtc: The p10 and p90 departure times as calendar times.
glossary.gateInUtc: The arrival timestamp the dwell forecast was measured from.
glossary.headlineAccuracyMaeH: Mean absolute error in hours ON A SEEDED SYNTHETIC GENERATOR. Not interchangeable with realCorpusMaeH.
glossary.realCorpusMaeH: UC2-M1 only: error on real container stays, published beside the synthetic headline and NOT interchangeable with it.
glossary.realCorpusBeatsBaseline: Whether M1 beats a plain median baseline on the real corpus. It does not. That is published, not hidden.
glossary.realCorpusBaselineMaeH: The median baseline M1 is measured against on the real corpus.
glossary.realStaysObserved: How many real container stays the corpus calibration saw.
glossary.calibrationSource: CORPUS when calibrated on real stays; a FALLBACK value means the corpus was unavailable and the figure is synthetic.
glossary.accuracyDisclosure: Why this model publishes two accuracies that must never be blended into one.
glossary.realCorpusMetricsAvailable: False when the real-stay error could not be recomputed in this deployment. The synthetic figure beside it is NOT a substitute for it.
glossary.realCorpusUnavailableReason: Why the real-corpus accuracy is missing, so a lone synthetic figure is never read as the whole story.
glossary.tatHours: Forecast hours the rake spends on the siding, arrival to departure.
glossary.etaPlacementH: Hours until the rake is placed on the siding.
glossary.etaRemovalH: Hours until the rake is removed from the siding.
glossary.departureWindowH: The band around the forecast rake departure, in hours.
glossary.fidelityMaeH: How closely the learned engine reproduces the deterministic handling model. This is FIDELITY, not accuracy.
glossary.metricIsFidelityNotAccuracy: UC2-M2 only: the error is measured against a deterministic model, not against an observed rake TAT, because the corpus has none.
glossary.realRakesExercised: How many real rakes the model was exercised against. Exercised, not scored -- there is no observed TAT to score to.
glossary.realTatMedianH: Median turnaround of the real rakes, for context only.
glossary.breakdown: Every term of the handling model with its arithmetic substituted -- the 'why' behind the number.
glossary.queueVehicles: Forecast vehicles queued at the gate in the next hour.
glossary.estimatedWaitMinutes: Forecast wait for a truck joining the queue now.
glossary.deferralRecommended: True when the forecast queue justifies telling hauliers to come later.
glossary.rmse: Root-mean-square error of the served model, in vehicles.
glossary.splitPolicy: Which train/test split produced the served metric. Rolling-origin is the one that counts; the others exist for comparison.
glossary.seriesSource: CORPUS when the real gate series was read; SYNTHETIC means the corpus was unavailable and the series was generated.
glossary.realGateMovements: How many real gate movements the series carried.
glossary.leakageCheck: UC2-M3 only: the same model scored under all three split protocols. servedRmse is the one that counts.
glossary.servedRmse: Error under the rolling-origin split -- the protocol actually served.
glossary.shuffledRmse: Error under a shuffled split. Published FOR COMPARISON ONLY: it leaks the future and always flatters the model.
glossary.tailRmse: Error on a chronological tail hold-out. For comparison only.
glossary.findings: The R1-R6 rules this container's event chain broke.
glossary.findingCount: How many rules the chain broke.
glossary.clean: True when the container's event chain broke no rule.
glossary.worstSeverity: Severity of the most serious finding: CRIT outranks WARN.
glossary.eventCount: How many lifecycle events the chain was assembled from.
glossary.trailUsed: The chronological event trail the rules were actually run on -- so a finding can be checked against what the model saw.
glossary.precision: Of the chains M4 flags, the share that really are broken.
glossary.recall: Of the broken chains present, the share M4 finds.
glossary.f1: The harmonic mean of precision and recall.
glossary.ruleId: Which of the R1-R6 rules produced this finding.
glossary.severity: How serious a single finding is.
glossary.reason: Why the rule fired, in words.
glossary.projectedTotalStayHours: Forecast total hours this vessel occupies the berth.
glossary.varianceVsPlanHours: Hours ahead of (negative) or behind (positive) the berthing plan.
glossary.status: The model's verdict in one word.
glossary.rateSource: 'observed' when the crane rate came from live TOS progress; anything else means an assumed rate and a weaker projection.
glossary.realCallsTracked: How many real TOS vessel calls the model was checked against.
glossary.meanStayVarianceH: Average plan-versus-actual berth-stay variance across those calls.
glossary.worstWaitMinutes: Longest wait any movement class faces under this lane plan.
glossary.throttleRecommended: True when the plan cannot serve demand and arrivals should be metered.
glossary.unservable: Movements per hour the open lanes cannot serve, by class.
glossary.closedLanes: Lanes reported down, which this plan works around.
glossary.waitIncreaseVsBaselineMin: Extra wait this plan carries versus the all-lanes-open baseline.
glossary.lanePlan: Which movement classes each open lane serves.
glossary.shortfall: Reefer containers with no plug to go to.
glossary.hoursToFirstRisk: Hours until the first reefer breaches its sensitivity hold time.
glossary.priorityEvacuation: Which reefers to move first, most temperature-sensitive first.
glossary.poolTotal: Containers in the yard snapshot this balance was computed from.
glossary.poolSource: CORPUS when the real line inventories were read; anything else means the pool is not measured.
glossary.shortTerminals: Terminals short of empties against their forecast demand.
glossary.balances: Empty surplus or deficit per terminal.
glossary.repositionPlan: Suggested empty moves between terminals to clear the deficits.
glossary.facility_scope: What set a facility-level figure describes -- deliberately NOT the single container on screen.
glossary.focus: True for the container the operator actually opened. It is scored first and is never dropped by the per-call cap.
glossary.models_run: Which models produced a block anywhere in this document.
glossary.containers_requested: How many containers the UI asked to score.
glossary.containers_scored: How many were actually scored in this call.
glossary.containers_dropped: How many were left out because the request exceeded the per-call cap.
glossary.models_failed: Models that raised in this run, with the error. A model that did not run is reported, never quietly omitted.
glossary.cadence_measured_rows: Rows whose arrival cadence was MEASURED from the batch rather than assumed. More is better.
glossary.cadence_assumed_rows: Rows that fell back to the named default cadence because the batch held no earlier arrival at their terminal.
glossary.inputs_observed: Model inputs that came from a column in the row.
glossary.inputs_assumed: Model inputs the row could not supply, so a published constant was used. Each one is named in assumptions.
glossary.assumptions: Every substitution this row's prediction rests on, in words.
glossary.warnings: Notes about the translation that do not change a value.
glossary.derived: One entry per model input: source column, raw value, mapped value, and the rule that did it.
glossary.adapter_version: Version of the translation layer between the UI row and the model contracts.
